abt.hist.cta.p: If your participation in dashAI is not listed on this page, you can write to us. We aim to keep a complete record of the project.
abt.hist.lead: The project has been under construction for several years. Undergraduate and graduate thesis students, research assistants and many others have taken part in it. Many of its current abstractions started as supervised projects or theses.
abt.lead: A Chilean academic project developed and maintained by a network of public and private institutions, with public funding and the work of a community of academics and students.
abt.m.p: Reduce technical barriers to the use of Machine Learning in research, teaching and applied work, while preserving the extensibility required by specialized groups. dashAI provides a visual interface over a modular architecture, auditable and open-source.
abt.v.p2: Consolidate a Chilean visual Machine Learning platform with two central attributes: local operation on user data and extensibility via community plugins. The project aspires to serve as shared infrastructure between research groups, public institutions and professionals.
abt.team.lead: The people who design, build and maintain dashAI day to day.

abt.inst.p: dashAI is a project of the Department of Computer Science of the Faculty of Physical and Mathematical Sciences at the University of Chile, developed in collaboration with IDIA, CENIA and Unholster, with funding from ANID through the Fondef IDEA ID25I10330 and Fondef VIU23P 0110 projects, and CENIA's basal funding (FB210017).
